We’ve done a thorough review of this and checked the areas of the system that handle customer categories and pricing assignments.

At this time, we did not find anything unusual or any unintended process that would automatically change Juan’s category or price level. We also checked related logs and code paths tied to customer category updates, and everything appears to be working as expected.

Since no other customers are currently experiencing the same issue, this looks to be an isolated case. It may require more information or steps to reproduce in order to determine the exact cause.

Please let us know if this happens again or if you notice a similar issue with any other account, and we’ll continue to investigate.

Best regards,

Hi Veteran Roofing & Exteriors Team,

After checking with our team, it appears that the order on StackShift cannot be changed — this is a known limitation of the platform.

However, we can send your form submissions directly to your CRM via webhook. This can be set up to send data to a Google Sheet, generate a PDF download, or another destination of your choice.

Would that be okay for you? If so, please let us know where you’d like the submissions sent, and we’ll take it from there.

Thank you!

Best regards,

StackShift
Powered by Talent, Driven by AI, Transformed by Technology

Nina Anjerrie R. Baraquil

Customer Support at WebriQ 

helpdesk@webriq.us
+1 516-858-2325
www.WebriQ.com

Hi Avalanche GR Team,

I hope you're doing well. I previously sent an email to schedule a call to clarify a few items, but I haven’t received a response yet, so I wanted to follow up here.

Looking back at the list of links your team provided, may I confirm—are these the updated content pieces you were referring to? If so, these are already live and published on the website.

That said, I’d like to clarify the direction moving forward in terms of layout. Several weeks ago, we received a request to build this page: https://www.gordonwater.com/water-softening/

This already includes the contact form in the hero section, consistent with the mockup your team provided. However, the form is not currently integrated with Brayv. Should this form now be removed?

You also mentioned previously that the old pages would need to be removed or redirected to the new versions. However, we haven’t received a list of the old URLs that require redirection. Kindly provide these old links.

If it would be helpful, we’re happy to hop on a quick call to go over these items in more detail. Please let us know your availability.

Looking forward to your confirmation.

Best regards,
StackShift
Powered by Talent, Driven by AI, Transformed by Technology

Niña Anjerrie R. Baraquil

Project Manager



nina.baraquil@webriq.services

www.WebriQ.com

content:
Hi Gordon Water Team,

Below are instructions based on your questions, along with two approaches for recreating existing pages using the new template:

1. How to create a new page using the template

To create a new page using the template, there are two main approaches:

Option 1: Duplicate the Template Page (Fastest Method)

  • Locate the existing template page.

  • Duplicate it. Make sure to create new copies of any components where you’ll be updating the content.

  • All components will be cloned, and new copies will be created.

  • You can then edit the content and publish the new page.

Option 2: Build a New Page from Scratch

  • Manually create a new page.

  • Add the pre-built components from the new template.

  • Insert your content.

  • Publish the page.

Option 1 is faster and ideal when you want to maintain the same layout and just change the content.

2. How to add or change the content based on the page being updated

  • Once the new page (or a duplicate) is created, each section/component can be edited individually.

  • You can change headings, text, images, and other content elements directly within each component.

  • If you have content prepared, you can paste it into the corresponding sections and adjust formatting as needed.

3. How to replace an existing page using the new template (e.g., https://www.gordonwater.com/water-softening/)

To replace an existing page using the new template, you can follow the steps from Option 1 (recommended):

  • Duplicate the template page.

  • Update all necessary content to reflect what’s currently on the existing page, using the new design.

  • Once the new page is ready, you can either:

    • Redirect the old URL to the new page, or

    • Replace the content of the existing URL with the new layout and content.

This way, you retain the updated layout and user experience while keeping or replacing the current page URL based on your SEO or navigation preferences.

However, if you’d like to update the layout of existing pages, it’s best to send them over to us so we can handle the updates.
For any new pages you’d like to create, feel free to base them on the instructions provided above.

Please let me know if you have any questions or if you'd like to discuss this over a quick call. Thank you!

Best regards,
Nina Anjerrie R. Baraquil
